_what: Third-party code and data bundled into the remotion tier's renders that is not a font (fonts: assets/fonts/OFL-*.txt). Versions are exact, as pinned in package.json; each licence was read from the package's own package.json/LICENSE at install time.

packages.name: d3-geo
packages.use: projections (orthographic, Equal Earth), spherical clipping, great-circle interpolation, geoPath

packages.name: topojson-client
packages.use: decodes the world-atlas TopoJSON into GeoJSON features and the shared-border mesh

packages.name: world-atlas
packages.use: Natural Earth country and land outlines as TopoJSON; the 1:110m and 1:50m files are imported (countries-110m, countries-50m, land-110m, land-50m), the 1:10m files are not

data.name: Natural Earth vector data
data.note: No attribution is required; country names and borders are Natural Earth's editorial choices (it shows de facto boundaries), so a film that names a disputed region should say whose boundary it is.
